text: Millets, coarse grains, have been a part of our Agriculture, Culture and Civilization since ancient times

text: In millets too, just like our culture, a lot of diversity is found

hi_text: जब सर्दियाँ आती हैं, तो इन बोरियों को गाय के रहने की जगह में, जिसे यहाँ खूड़ कहते हैं, उसमें बिछा दिया जाता है

text: During snowfall, these sacks give protection to the cows from the cold
hi_text: बर्फबारी के बीच, ये बोरियाँ, गायों को, ठंड से सुरक्षा देती हैं

text: After winters, this cow dung is used as manure in the fields
hi_text: सर्दियाँ जाने के बाद, यही गोबर, खेतों में खाद के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया जाता है

text: That is, the animals' protection using animal waste, and also manure for the fields
hi_text: यानी, पशुओं के वास्ते से ही उनकी सुरक्षा भी, और खेतों के लिए खाद भी

text: The cost of cultivation is also low, and the yield in the fields is also high
hi_text: खेती की लागत भी कम, और खेत में उपज भी ज्यादा

text: That is why this area, these days, is also becoming an inspiration for natural farming
hi_text: इसीलिए तो ये क्षेत्र, इन दिनों, प्राकृतिक खेती के लिए भी एक प्रेरणा बन रहा है

text: Friends, many such commendable efforts are also being seen in our, other hill state, Uttarakhand
hi_text: साथियो, इसी तरह के कई सराहनीय प्रयास, हमारे, एक और पहाड़ी राज्य, उत्तराखंड में भी देखने को मिल रहे हैं

text: Many types of medicines and plants are found in Uttarakhand, which are very beneficial for our health
hi_text: उत्तराखंड में कई प्रकार के औषधि और वनस्पतियाँ पाई जाती हैं

text: One of them is the fruit Bedu
hi_text: उन्हीं में से एक फल है बेडू

text: It is also known as Himalayan Fig
hi_text: इसे, हिमालयन फिग के नाम से भी जाना जाता है

text: In this fruit, minerals and vitamins are found in abundance
hi_text: इस फल में, खनिज और विटामिन भरपूर मात्रा में पाये जाते हैं

text: People consume it not only in the form of fruit, but it is also used in the treatment of many diseases
hi_text: लोग, फल के रूप में तो इसका सेवन करते ही हैं, साथ ही कई बीमारियों के इलाज में भी इसका उपयोग होता है

text: In view of these qualities of this fruit, now the juice of Bedu, jams, chutneys, pickles and dry fruits prepared by drying them have been launched in the market
hi_text: इस फल की इन्हीं खूबियों को देखते हुए अब बेडू के जूस, इससे बने जैम, चटनी, अचार और इन्हें सुखाकर तैयार किए गए ड्राई फ्रूट को बाजार में उतारा गया है

text: With the initiative of the Pithoragarh administration and the cooperation of the local people, it has been successful in bringing Bedu to the market in different forms
hi_text: पिथौरागढ़ प्रशासन की पहल और स्थानीय लोगों के सहयोग से, बेडू को बाजार तक अलगअलग रूपों में पहुँचाने में सफलता मिली है

text: Bedu has also been launched in the online market by branding it as Pahari Fig
hi_text: बेडू को पहाड़ी अंजीर के नाम से ब्रांडिंग करके ओनलाइन मार्केट में भी उतारा गया है

text: Due to this, farmers have not only found a new source of income, but the benefits of the medicinal properties of Bedu have started reaching far and wide as well
hi_text: इससे किसानों को आय का नया स्त्रोत तो मिला ही है, साथ ही बेडू के औषधीय गुणों का फायदा दूरदूर तक पहुँचने लगा है

text: My dear countrymen, in the beginning of 'Mann Ki Baat', today, we referred to the Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav
hi_text: मेरे प्यारे देशवासियो, 'मन की बात' में आज शुरुआत में हमने आजादी के अमृत महोत्सव के बारे में बात की है

text: Along with the great festival of Independence Day, many more festivals are lined up in the coming days
hi_text: स्वतंत्रता दिवस के महान पर्व के साथसाथ आने वाले दिनों में और भी कई पर्व आने वाले हैं

text: Just a few days from now, is the festival of Ganesh Chaturthi, the festival of worship of Bhagwan Ganesha
hi_text: अभी कुछ दिन बाद ही भगवान गणेश की आराधना का पर्व गणेश चतुर्थी है

text: Ganesh Chaturthi, that is, the festival of blessings of Ganpati Bappa
hi_text: गणेश चतुर्थी, यानी गणपति बप्पा के आशीर्वाद का पर्व

text: The festival of Onam is also commencing before Ganesh Chaturthi
hi_text: गणेश चतुर्थी के पहले ओणम का पर्व भी शुरू हो रहा है

text: Onam, especially in Kerala, will be celebrated with a sense of peace and prosperity
hi_text: विशेष रूप से केरला में ओणम शांति और समृद्धि की भावना के साथ मनाया जाएगा

text: Hartalika Teej too is on the 30th of August
hi_text: 30 अगस्त को हरतालिका तीज भी है

text: The festival of Nuakhai will also be celebrated in Odisha on the 1st of September
hi_text: ओडिशा में 1 सितंबर को नुआखाई का पर्व भी मनाया जाएगा

text: Nuakhai simply means new food, that is, this too, like many other festivals, is a festival associated with our agricultural traditions
hi_text: नुआखाई का मतलब ही होता है, नया खाना, यानी, ये भी, दूसरे कई पर्वों की तरह ही, हमारी, कृषि परंपरा से जुड़ा त्योहार है

text: Meanwhile, there will also be the Samvatsari festival of the Jain community
hi_text: इसी बीच, जैन समाज का संवत्सरी पर्व भी होगा

text: All these festivals of ours are synonymous with our cultural prosperity and vitality
hi_text: हमारे ये सभी पर्व, हमारी सांस्कृतिक समृद्धि और जीवंतता के पर्याय हैं

text: I wish you all the best for these festivals and special occasions
hi_text: मैं, आप सभी को, इन त्योहारों और विशेष अवसरों के लिए शुभकामनाएँ देता हूँ

text: Along with these festivals, tomorrow on the 29th of August, National Sports Day will also be celebrated on the birth anniversary of Major Dhyanchand ji
hi_text: इन पर्वों के साथसाथ, कल 29 अगस्त को, मेजर ध्यानचंद जी की जन्मजयंती पर राष्ट्रीय खेल दिवस भी मनाया जाएगा

text: May our young sportspersons continue to raise the glory of our tricolor on global forums, this will be our tribute to Dhyan Chand ji
hi_text: हमारे युवा खिलाड़ी वैश्विक मंचों पर हमारे तिरंगे की शान बढ़ाते रहें, यही हमारी ध्यानचंद जी के प्रति श्रद्दांजलि होगी

text: Let us all keep working together for the country like this; keep raising the honor of the country...With this wish I conclude my point
hi_text: देश के लिए हम सभी मिलकर ऐसे ही काम करते रहें, देश का मान बढ़ाते रहें, इसी कामना के साथ मैं अपनी बात समाप्त करता हूँ

text: Next month, we will have 'Mann Ki Baat' once again
hi_text: अगले माह, एक बार फिर आपसे 'मन की बात' होगी

text: Thank you very much
hi_text: बहुतबहुत धन्यवाद

text: My dear fellow citizens, Namaskar
hi_text: मेरे प्यारे देशवासियो, आप सबको नमस्कार

text: It's summer
Everybody makes plans for their summer holidays
hi_text: छुट्टियों में कई कार्यक्रम हर कोई बनाता है

text: Since this is the season of mangoes, we crave for the flavour and taste of this fruit
hi_text: और छुट्टियों में आम का सीजन होता है, तो ये भी मन करता है कि आम का मज़ा लें और कभी ये भी मन करता है कि कुछ पल दोपहर को सोने का मौका मिल जाए, तो अच्छा होगा

text: Sometimes we feel a nap in the afternoon would be nice
hi_text: और छुट्टियों में आम का सीजन होता है, तो ये भी मन करता है कि आम का मज़ा लें और कभी ये भी मन करता है कि कुछ पल दोपहर को सोने का मौका मिल जाए, तो अच्छा होगा

text: But this year the sweltering heat has spoilt the fun for everybody
hi_text: लेकिन इस बार की भयंकर गर्मी ने चारों तरफ सारा मज़ा किरकिरा कर दिया है

text: It is quite natural for the nation to feel concerned about the unrelenting heat
hi_text: ये चिंता बहुत स्वाभाविक है

text: On top of it, due to continuous drought over the past couple of years, the usual water storage facilities have been adversely affected
hi_text: देश में चिंता होना बहुत स्वाभाविक है और उसमें भी, जब लगातार सूखा पड़ता है, तो पानीसंग्रह के जो स्थान होते हैं, वो भी कम पड़ जाते हैं

text: Sometimes due to encroachment, sometimes due to silting, the inflow of water into reservoirs and other water bodies gets blocked
hi_text: कभीकभार एन्क्रोचमेंट के कारण, सिल्टिंग के कारण, पानी आने के जो प्रवाह हैं, उसमें रुकावटों के कारण, जलाशय भी अपनी क्षमता से काफी कम पानी संग्रहीत करते हैं और सालों के क्रम के कारण उसकी संग्रहक्षमता भी कम हो जाती है

text: As a result, the reservoirs store much less water than their capacity
hi_text: कभीकभार एन्क्रोचमेंट के कारण, सिल्टिंग के कारण, पानी आने के जो प्रवाह हैं, उसमें रुकावटों के कारण, जलाशय भी अपनी क्षमता से काफी कम पानी संग्रहीत करते हैं और सालों के क्रम के कारण उसकी संग्रहक्षमता भी कम हो जाती है

text: Worse, because of this cycle that has been going on for years, the capacity itself of these reservoirs is gradually reduced
hi_text: कभीकभार एन्क्रोचमेंट के कारण, सिल्टिंग के कारण, पानी आने के जो प्रवाह हैं, उसमें रुकावटों के कारण, जलाशय भी अपनी क्षमता से काफी कम पानी संग्रहीत करते हैं और सालों के क्रम के कारण उसकी संग्रहक्षमता भी कम हो जाती है

text: To cope with the drought and to provide relief from the water crisis, governments are making efforts
hi_text: सूखे से निपटने के लिए पानी के संकट से राहत के लिए सरकारें अपना प्रयास करें, वो तो है, लेकिन मैंने देखा है कि नागरिक भी बहुत ही अच्छे प्रयास करते हैं

text: But that's not all
hi_text: लेकिन बात वहीं की वहीं रह जाती थी

text: I have noticed that citizens are doing commendable work to help deal with the situation
hi_text: मैं ऐसे सभी गाँववासियों को भी बहुतबहुत बधाई देता हूँ आपके इस उत्तम काम के लिए

text: Awareness is now seen in many villages
hi_text: इस अभियान ने एक बहुत बड़ा जागरूकता का काम किया है

text: Only those who have faced shortage of water know the real value of water
hi_text: कई गाँवों में जागरूकता देखी जाती है और पानी का मूल्य क्या है, वो तो वही जानते हैं, जिन्होनें पानी की तकलीफ़ झेली है

text: Hence, in such places they are very sensitive about water and are equally active in doing something to deal with the shortage of water
hi_text: और इसलिए ऐसी जगह पर, पानी के संबंध में एक संवेदनशीलता भी होती है और कुछनकुछ करने की सक्रियता भी होती है

text: I was recently told that in Ahmednagar district of Maharashtra, the Hivrebazaar Gram Panchayat and its villagers have addressed the problem of water shortage by treating it as a major and delicate issue
hi_text: मुझे कुछ दिन पहले कोई बता रहा था कि महाराष्ट्र के अहमदनगर ज़िले के हिवरे बाज़ार ग्राम पंचायत और वहाँ के गाँव वालों ने पानी को गाँव के एक बहुत बड़े संवेदनशील इश्यू के रूप में एड्रेस किया

text: One can find many villages where there is a desire to store water
hi_text: कई गाँवों में जागरूकता देखी जाती है और पानी का मूल्य क्या है, वो तो वही जानते हैं, जिन्होनें पानी की तकलीफ़ झेली है

text: At Hivrebazaar the farmers tackled the issue by changing the cropping pattern
hi_text: जल संचय करने की इच्छा करने वाले तो कई गाँव मिल जाते हैं, लेकिन इन्होंने तो किसानों के साथ बातचीत करके पूरी क्रॉपिंग पैटर्न बदल दी

text: They have decided to give up cultivation of those crops that require a lot of water, like sugarcane and banana
hi_text: ऐसी फसल, जो सबसे ज्यादा पानी उपयोग करती थी, चाहे गन्ना हो, केला हो, ऐसी फसलों को छोड़ने का निर्णय कर लिया

text: It sounds very simple, but in reality it is not so
hi_text: सुनने में बात बहुत सरल लगती है, लेकिन इतनी सरल नहीं है

text: What a big collective decision this must have been
hi_text: बहुत कोआर्डिनेशन की आवश्यकता लगी मुझे

text: If one tells the owners of factories that consume a lot of water about the consequences of this consumption and requests them to shut down their units, one can well imagine what the response would be
hi_text: सबने मिल करके कितना बड़ा संकल्प किया होगा? किसी कारख़ाना वाला पानी का उपयोग करता हो, कहोगे, तुम कारख़ाना बंद करो, क्योंकि पानी ज्यादा लेते हो, तो क्या परिणाम आएगा, आप जानते हैं

text: But see the sensibility of these farmer brothers
hi_text: और कितना बड़ा फैलाव है उनका, कितने परिवारों तक ये पहुँचे हुए हैं

text: When they realised that the cultivation of the sugarcane should be given up because it consumed a lot of water, they went ahead and did it
hi_text: लेकिन ये मेरे किसान भाई, देखिए, उनको लगा कि भाई, गन्ना बहुत पानी लेता है, तो गन्ना छोड़ो, उन्होंने छोड़ दिया

text: Instead of sugarcane, they have taken to such crops like fruits and vegetables that require much less water
hi_text: और पूरा उन्होंने फ्रूट और वेजिटेबल, जिसमें कमसेकम पानी की ज़रूरत पड़ती है, ऐसी फसलों पर चले गए

text: Farmers in this village have taken so many initiatives such as using sprinklers, drip irrigation techniques, water harvesting and water recharging, that today their village is strong enough to cope with the water crisis that they face
hi_text: उन्होंने स्प्रिंकलर, ड्रिप इरिगेशन, टपक सिंचाई, वाटर हार्वेस्टिंग, वाटर रिचार्जिंग इतने सारे इनिशिएटिव लिये कि आज गाँव पानी के संकट के सामने जूझने के लिए अपनी ताकत पर खड़ा हो गया

text: I might be talking of a small place like Hivrebazaar, but there must be many other such villages
hi_text: ठीक है, मैं एक छोटे से गाँव हिवरे बाज़ार की चर्चा भले करता हूँ, लेकिन ऐसे कई गाँव होंगे

text: I extend my hearty felicitations to such villagers for their fine work
hi_text: मैं ऐसे सभी गाँववासियों को भी बहुतबहुत बधाई देता हूँ आपके इस उत्तम काम के लिए

text: I was told that in Devas district of Madhya Pradesh, the Gorva Gram Panchayat took up the drive to create farm ponds
hi_text: मुझे किसी ने बताया कि मध्य प्रदेश में देवास ज़िले में गोरवा गाँव पंचायत

text: They have already created 27 farm ponds
hi_text: करीब 27 फार्म पोंड्स बनाए और उसके कारण ग्राउंड वाटर लेवेल में बढ़ोत्तरी हुई, पानी ऊपर आया

text: Due to this there has been an increase in the ground water level
hi_text: तो ज़मीन में पानी के लेवेल ऊपर आयेंगे

text: Whenever water was required for crops, farmers had access to it
hi_text: जब भी पानी की ज़रूरत पड़ी फ़सल को, पानी मिला और वो मोटामोटा हिसाब बताते थे, करीब उनकी कृषि उत्पादन में 20 प्रतिशत वृद्धि हुई

text: This panchayat has given a rough estimate that their agricultural production has increased by 20 per cent
hi_text: पंचायत ने प्रयत्न करके फार्म पोंड बनाने का अभियान चलाया

text: Not only has water been saved, the quality of water has also vastly improved with the water level increasing

text: World over it is said that potable water can contributing factor for GDP growth

text: You would be aware that for the facilities and respect that workers have earned, we are grateful to Babasaheb

My dear countrymen, Namaskar
I extend a warm welcome to you all in 'Mann Ki Baat', once again
This programmme is the 95th episode
We are fast moving towards the century of 'Mann Ki Baat'
This programmme is another medium for me to connect with a 130 crore countrymen
Before every episode, reading letters from villages and cities, listening to audio messages from children to elders; it is like a spiritual experience for me
Friends, I want to start today's program referring to a unique gift
There is a weaver brother in Rajanna Sircilla district of Telangana YeldhiHariprasad Garu
He has sent me this G20 logo woven with his own hands
I was surprised to see this wonderful gift
Hariprasad ji is such an expert in his art that he attracts everyone's attention
Hariprasad ji has also sent me a letter along with this handwoven G20 logo
In this he has written that it is a matter of great pride for India to host the G20 summit next year
Amid the joy of this achievement of the country, he has prepared this logo of G20 with his own hands
He has inherited this wonderful talent of weaving from his father and today he is engaged in it with full passion
Friends, a few days ago I had the privilege of launching the G20 logo and the website of the Presidency of India
This logo was chosen through a public contest
When I received this gift sent by Hariprasad Garu, another thought came to my mind
I was very happy to see how connected even a person sitting in a district of Telangana could feel with a summit like G20
Today, many people like Hariprasad Garu have sent letters to me saying that their hearts have swelled with pride at the country hosting such a big summit
I will also mention to you the message of Subba Rao Chillara ji from Pune and Tushar Jagmohan from Kolkata
They have highly appreciated India's proactive efforts regarding G20
Friends, the G20 has a partnership comprising twothirds of the world's population, threefourths of world trade, and 85% of world GDP
You can imagine India is going to preside over such a big group, such a powerful group, 3 days from now i
e
from the 1st of December

Friends, the Presidency of G20 has arrived as a big opportunity for us
We have to make full use of this opportunity and focus on Global Good, world welfare
Whether it is peace or unity, sensitivity towards the environment, or sustainable development, India has solutions to challenges related to these
The theme that we have given "One Earth, One Family, One Future" shows our commitment to Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam
We always say
Om Sarvesham Swastirbhavatu
Sarvesham Shanti Bhavatu
Sarvesham Purnambhavatu

During this period, people from different parts of the world will get a chance to visit your states

I am sure that you will bring the diverse and distinctive colors of your culture to the world and you also have to remember that the people coming to the G20, even if they come now as delegates, are tourists of the future

in website, you will find many things there according to your interest
My dear countrymen, on the 18th of November, the whole country witnessed new history being made in the space sector
On this day, India sent its first such rocket into space, which was designed and prepared by the private sector of India
The name of this rocket is 'VikramS'
As soon as this first rocket of the indigenous Space Startup made a historic flight from Sriharikota, the heart of every Indian swelled with pride
Friends, 'VikramS' Rocket is equipped with many features
It is also lighter than other rockets, and also cheaper
Its development cost is much less than the cost incurred by other countries involved in space missions
In space technology, World class standard at a low cost, has now become the hallmark of India
Another modern technology has been used in making this rocket
You will be surprised to know that some crucial parts of this rocket have been made through 3D Printing
Surely, the name 'Prarambh' given to the launch mission of 'VikramS', suits it perfectly
This marks the dawn of a new era for the private space sector in India
This is the beginning of a new era full of selfconfidence for the country
You can imagine the children who once made paper airplanes and used to fly them with their hands are now getting a chance to make airplanes in India itself
You can imagine those children who once used to draw shapes in the sky, looking at the moon and stars, are now getting a chance to make rockets in India itself
After space was opened to the private sector, these dreams of the youth are also coming true
As if these youth making rockets are saying, Sky is not the limit
Friends, India is sharing its success in the space sector with its neighbouring countries as well
Just yesterday, India launched a satellite, which has been jointly developed by India and Bhutan
This satellite will send pictures of very good resolution which will help Bhutan in the management of its natural resources
The launching of this satellite is a reflection of the strong IndoBhutan relations
Friends, you must have noticed that in the last few episodes of 'Mann Ki Baat', we discussed a lot on Space, Tech, Innovation
There are two special reasons for this one is that our youth are doing wonderful work in this field
They are thinking Big and Achieving Big
Now they are not going to be satisfied with small achievements
Secondly, in this exciting journey of innovation and value creation, they are also encouraging their other young colleagues and startups
Friends, when we are talking about innovations related to technology, how can we forget drones
India is also moving fast in the field of drones
A few days ago we saw how apples were transported through drones in Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh
Kinnaur is a remote district of Himachal and there is heavy snowfall in this season
With this much snowfall, Kinnaur's connectivity with the rest of the state becomes very difficult for weeks
In such a situation, the transportation of apples from there is equally difficult
Now with the help of Drone Technology, delicious Kinnauri apples of Himachal will start reaching people more quickly
This will reduce the expenditure of our farmer brothers and sisters apples will reach the market on time, there will be less wastage of apples
Friends, Today our countrymen are making things possible with their innovations, which could not even be imagined earlier
Who would not be happy to see this
In recent years, our country has undertaken a long journey of achievements
I have full faith that we Indians and especially our young generation are not going to stop now
Dear countrymen, I am going to play a small clip for you...
Song
All of you must have heard this song sometime or the other
After all, this is Bapu'sfavorite song, but if I tell you that the singers who have sung it are from Greece, you will definitely be surprised
And this will also fill you with pride
This song has been sung by the singer from Greece 'Konstantinos Kalaitzis'
He had sung it during the 150th birth anniversary celebrations of Gandhiji
But today I am discussing him for some other reason
He has a great passion for India and Indian music
He has so much affection for India, that in the last 42 forty two years he has come to India almost every year
He has studied about the origin of Indian music, different Indian musical systems, different types of ragas, talas and rasas as well as different gharanas
He has studied the contribution of many great personalities of Indian music; he has also closely understood the different aspects of classical dances of India
Now he has put together all these experiences related to India very beautifully in a book
There are about 760 pictures in his book named Indian Music
Most of these photographs have been taken by he himself
Such enthusiasm and fascination for Indian culture in other countries is really heartening
Friends, a few weeks ago another news came which is going to fill us with pride
You will be pleased to know that in the last 8 years the export of musical instruments from India has increased three and a half times
Talking about Electrical Musical Instruments; their export has increased 60 times
This shows that the craze for Indian culture and music is increasing all over the world
The biggest buyers of Indian Musical Instruments are developed countries like USA, Germany, France, Japan and UK
It is a matter of fortune for all of us that our country has such a rich heritage of Music, Dance and Art
Friends, we all know the great sage poet Bhartrihari for his 'Niti Shatak'
In one of the verses he says that one's attachment to art, music and literature is the real identity of humanity
In fact, our culture takes it above Humanity, to Divinity
In the Vedas, Samaveda has been called the source of our diverse music
Be it the Veena of Maa Saraswati, the flute of Bhagwan Krishna, or the Damru of Bholenath, our Gods and Goddesses are also attached with music
We Indians find music in everything
Be it the murmur of a river, the raindrops, the chirping of birds or the resonating sound of the wind, music is present everywhere in our civilization
This music relaxes not only the body, but also gives joy to the mind
Music also connects our society
If Bhangra and Lavani have a sense of fervor and joy, Rabindra Sangeet lifts our souls
Tribals across the country have different musical traditions
They inspire us to live in harmony with each other and with nature
Friends, Our forms of music have not only enriched our culture, but have also left an indelible mark on the music of the world
The fame of Indian music has spread to every corner of the world
Let me play to you one more audio clip
Song
You must be thinking that bhajan kirtan is being performed in some temple in the neighbourhood
But these notes have reached you from Guyana, a South American country thousands of miles away from India
In the 19th and 20th centuries, a large number of people from here went to Guyana
They also took many traditions of India with them from here
For example, as we celebrate Holi in India, in Guyana also the colors of Holi come alive with zest
Where there are colors of Holi, there is also the music of Phagwa that is Phagua
In Phagwa of Guyana there is a special tradition of singing wedding songs associated with Bhagwan Rama and Bhagwan Krishna
These songs are called Chautal
They are sung on the similar type of tune and at a high pitch as we do here
Not only this, Chautal Competitions are also held in Guyana
Similarly, many Indians, especially people from eastern Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, had gone to Fiji too
They used to sing traditional bhajankirtans, mainly couplets from the Ramcharitmanas
They also formed many Mandalis associated with bhajankirtan in Fiji
Even today there are more than two thousand BhajanKirtan Mandalis in Fiji by the name of Ramayana Mandali
Today they can be seen in every village and locality
I have given only a few examples here
If you see in the whole world, then this list of lovers of Indian music is very long
My dear countrymen, we all always take pride in the fact that our country is home to the oldest traditions in the world
Therefore, it is also our responsibility to preserve our traditions and traditional knowledge, to promote it and to take it forward as much as possible
One such commendable effort is being made by some friends of our northeastern state of Nagaland
I liked this effort very much, so I thought, I'd share it with the listeners of 'Mann Ki Baat'
Friends, the lifestyle of the Naga community in Nagaland, their artculture and music attracts everyone
It is an important part of the glorious heritage of our country
The life of the people of Nagaland and their skills are also very important for a sustainable life style
In order to save these traditions and skills and pass them on to the next generation, the people there have formed an organization, that's name is 'LidiCroU'
' The organization has undertaken the work of reviving beautiful facets of Naga culture which were on the verge of being lost
For example, Naga folk music is a very rich genre in itself
This organization has started the work of launching Naga Music Albums
So far, three such albums have been launched
These people also organize workshops related to folk music and folk dance
Youth are also given training for all these
Not only this, the youth are also trained in the traditional Nagaland style of apparel making, tailoring and weaving
Many types of products are made from bamboo in the Northeast
The youth of the new generation are also taught to make bamboo products
With this, these youth not only get connected with their culture, but also create new employment opportunities for them
People at LidiCroU try to make more and more people know about Naga folkculture
Friends, there will be such cultural styles and traditions in your region too
You too can make such efforts in your respective areas
If you are aware of any such unique effort being made somewhere, then you must share that information with me as well
My dear countrymen, we it has been said here
Vidyadhanam Sarva Dhanam Pradhanam
That is, if someone is donating knowledge, then he is doing the noblest work in the interest of the society
Even a small lamp lit in the field of education can illuminate the whole society
It gives me great pleasure to see that many such efforts are being made across the country today
Bansa is a village in Hardoi, 7080 kilometres away from Lucknow, the capital of UP
I have come to know about Jatin Lalit Singh ji of this village, who is engaged in kindling the flame of education
Jatin ji had started a 'Community Library and Resource Centre' here two years ago
, His centre has more than 3000 books related to Hindi and English literature, computer, law and preparing for many government exams
In this library, the choice of the children has also been taken full care of
Whether it is comic books or educational toys present here, children are very fond of them
Small children come here to learn new things while playing
Be it offline or online education, about 40 volunteers are busy guiding the students at this center
Everyday about 80 students of the village come to study in this library
Friends, Sanjay Kashyap ji of Jharkhand is also giving new wings to the dreams of poor children
In his student life, Sanjay ji had to face the paucity of good books
In such a situation, he decided that, he would not let the future of the children of his region be dark, due to lack of books
Because of this mission, today he has become the 'Library Man' for children in many districts of Jharkhand
When Sanjay ji had started working, he had got the first library built at his native place
Wherever he was transferred during his job, he would get involved in the mission of opening a library for the education of poor and tribal children
While doing this, he has opened libraries for children in many districts of Jharkhand
His mission to open a library is taking the form of a social movement today
Be it Sanjay ji or Jatin ji, I especially appreciate them for their myriad such efforts

My dear countrymen, the world of medical science has made a lot of progress with the help of research and innovation as well as stateoftheart technology and equipment, but some diseases, even today, remain a big challenge for us
One such disease is Muscular Dystrophy
It is mainly a genetic disease that can occur at any age, in which the muscles of the body begin to weaken
It becomes difficult for the patient to do even his small tasks of daily life
The treatment and care of such patients require great sense of service
We have such a centre at Solan in Himachal Pradesh, which has become a new ray of hope for the patients of Muscular Dystrophy
The name of this centre is 'Manav Mandir'; it is being run by the Indian Association of Muscular Dystrophy
Manav Mandir is a wonderful example of human service true to its name
OPD and admission services for the patients started here threefour years ago
Manav Mandir also has the facility of beds for about 50 patients
Along with Physiotherapy, Electrotherapy, and Hydrotherapy, diseases are also treated here with the help of YogaPranayama
Friends, through all kinds of hitech facilities, this centre also tries to bring a positive change in the lives of the patients
A challenge associated with Muscular Dystrophy is also a lack of awareness about it
That's why, this centre organizes awareness camps for patients not only in Himachal Pradesh but across the country

The most encouraging thing is that the management of this organization is mainly done by people suffering from this disease, like social worker, Urmila Baldi ji, President of Indian Association Of Muscular Dystrophy Sister Sanjana Goyal ji, and other members of this association
Shriman Vipul Goyal ji, who played an important role in the formation, is playing a very important role for this institution
Efforts are also on to develop Manav Mandir as a hospital and research centre
With this, patients will be able to get better treatment here
I heartily appreciate all the people trying in this direction, as well as wish the best for recovery of all the people suffering from Muscular Dystrophy
My dear countrymen, the creative and social endeavours of the countrymen that we discussed in today's 'Mann Ki Baat' are examples of the country's energy and enthusiasm
Today every countryman is trying to do something different for the country in one field or the other, at every level
In today's discussion itself, we saw that in an international event like G20, one of our weaver companions understood his responsibility and came forward to fulfil it
Similarly, some are making efforts for the environment, others are working for water; many people are doing extraordinary work... from education, medicine and science technology to culturetraditions
This is because, today every citizen of ours is realising one's duties
When such a sense of duty rises within the citizens of a nation, its golden future is automatically ensured, and, in the golden future of the country itself, also lies for all of us, a golden future
I once again salute the countrymen for their efforts
We will meet again next month and will definitely talk about many more such encouraging topics
Do keep sending your suggestions and ideas
Many thanks to all of you
My dear countrymen, Namaskar

text: Friends, I want to tell you about the efforts of Saayee Praneeth ji

text: Saayee Praneeth ji is a Software Engineer, hailing from Andhra Paradesh

text: Last year he saw that in his area farmers had to suffer a lot due to the vagaries of weather
hi_text: पिछले वर्ष उन्होंने देखा कि उनके यहाँ मौसम की मार की वजह से किसानों को काफी नुकसान उठाना पड़ा था

text: So, he decided to use his interest and talent for the welfare of farmers

text: Now he purchases weather data from different data sources, analyses them and sends necessary information through various media to farmers in local language

text: Besides weather updates, Praneeth ji also gives guidance to people about what they should do in different climatic conditions... Especially how to be safe from floods or how to avoid storm or lightning, he talks about this too

text: He is earning a lot through his YouTube Channel
hi_text: अपने यूट्यूब चैनल से वो काफ़ी रुपये कमा रहे हैं

text: In his videos he shows prominently the local dishes, traditional ways of cooking, his village, his lifestyle, family and food habits

text: His journey as a YouTuber began in March 2020 when he posted a video related to Pakhal, the famous local dish of Odisha

text: Since then, he has posted hundreds of videos

text: This effort of his is different for many reasons

text: Specially because through this, people living in cities get a chance to watch the lifestyle about which they don't know much

text: Isaak Munda ji is celebrating by blending culture and cuisine equally and inspiring us too

text: Friends, while we are discussing technology I want to discuss of an interesting subject
hi_text: साथियो, जब हम टेक्नोलॉजी की चर्चा कर रहे हैं तो मैं एक और इंटरेस्टिंग विषय की चर्चा करना चाहता हूँ

hi_text: मैं आप को निमंत्रण देता हूँ कि कैशलेस सोसाइटी बनाने में आप बहुत बड़ा योगदान दे सकते हैं, आप अपने व्यापार को बढ़ाने में, मोबाइल फोन पर पूरी बैंकिंग व्यवस्था खड़ी कर सकते हैं और आज नोटों के सिवाय अनेक रास्ते हैं, जिससे हम कारोबार चला सकते हैं

text: There are technological methods which are safe, secure and instantaneous
hi_text: टेक्नोलॉजिकल रास्ते हैं, सफे है, सिक्योर है और त्वरित है

text: I want that you not only extend your cooperation in making this campaign successful but also lead the process of transformation and I have full confidence that you can be the leader for this change
hi_text: मैं चाहूँगा कि आप सिर्फ़ इस अभियान को सफल करने के लिए मदद करें, इतना नहीं, आप बदलाव का भी नेतृत्व करें और मुझे विश्वास है, आप बदलाव का नेतृत्व कर सकते हैं

text: I am sure you can handle the entire business in your village using this technology
hi_text: आप पूरे गाँव के कारोबार में ये टेक्नोलॉजी के आधार पर काम कर सकते हैं, मेरा विश्वास है

text: I want to tell my worker brothers and sisters too that you have faced heavy exploitation
hi_text: I मैं मज़दूर भाइयोंबहनों को भी कहना चाहता हूँ, आप का बहुत शोषण हुआ है

text: Wages shown on paper are much higher than the wages actually paid to you
hi_text: कागज़ पर एक पगार होता है और जब हाथ में दिया जाता है, तब दूसरा होता है

text: If sometimes full wages are paid, someone stands outside to forcibly take his cut and the worker is compelled to accept this as his fate
hi_text: कभी पगार पूरा मिलता है, तो बाहर कोई खड़ा होता है, उसको कट देना पड़ता है और मज़दूर मजबूरन इस शोषण को जीवन का हिस्सा बना देता है

text: We want that under this new system you should have a bank account; your wages should be deposited directly into your bank so that payment of minimum wages is ensured
hi_text: इस नई व्यवस्था से हम चाहते हैं कि आपका बैंक में खाता हो, आपके पगार के पैसे आपके बैंक में जमा हों, ताकि मिनिमम वेजेस का पालन हो

text: You get your due wages in full, without anybody extracting a cut
hi_text: आपको पूरा पैसा मिले, कोई कट ना करे

text: No one should exploit you
hi_text: आपका शोषण न हो

text: And, once the money is credited into your bank account, you can use your mobile phone as an ewallet and you do not need any hifi smart phone for this, because even with the help of your ordinary mobile phone itself you can make purchases from the neighbourhood shops and make payments as well
hi_text: और एक बार आपके बैंक खाते में पैसे आ गए, तो आप भी तो छोटे से मोबाइल फ़ोन पर कोई बड़ा स्मार्ट फोन की ज़रूरत नहीं हैं, आजकल तो आपका मोबाइल फोन भी ईबटुवे का काम करता है आप उसी मोबाइल फोन से अड़ोसपड़ोस की छोटीमोटी दुकान में जो भी खरीदना है, खरीद भी सकते हैं, उसी से पैसे भी दे सकते हैं

text: That is why, I specially urge our worker brothers and sisters to participate in this scheme because after all I took such a momentous decision for the benefit of the poor people, the farmers, the workers, the deprived and the suffering people of the country and, hence, these benefits must reach them
hi_text: इसलिए मैं मज़दूर भाइयोंबहनों को इस योजना में भागीदार बनने के लिए विशेष आग्रह करता हूँ, क्योंकि आखिरकार इतना बड़ा मैंने निर्णय देश के ग़रीब के लिये, किसान के लिये, मज़दूर के लिये, वंचित के लिये, पीड़ित के लिये लिया है, उसका बेनेफिट उसको मिलना चाहिए

text: I specially want to talk to our young friends today
hi_text: आज मैं विशेष रूप से युवक मित्रों से बात करना चाहता हूँ

text: We keep telling with great fanfare the whole world that India is a country where 65% of the population is below the age of 35 years
hi_text: हम दुनिया में गाजेबाजे के साथ कहते हैं कि भारत ऐसा देश है कि जिसके पास 65% जनसंख्या, 35 साल से कम उम्र की है

text: I know, dear young men and women of my country, that you have liked my decision
hi_text: आप मेरे देश के युवा और युवतियाँ, मैं जानता हूँ, मेरा निर्णय तो आपको पसन्द आया है

text: I also know that you support my decision
hi_text: मैं ये भी जानता हूँ कि आप इस निर्णय का समर्थन करते हैं

text: I even know that you are making a big contribution in positively taking this mission forward
hi_text: मैं ये भी जानता हूँ कि आप इस बात को सकारात्मक रूप से आगे बढ़ाने के लिए बहुत योगदान भी करते हैं

text: But dear friends, you are my true soldiers, my true partners
hi_text: लेकिन दोस्तो, आप मेरे सच्चे सिपाही हो, आप मेरे सच्चे साथी हो

text: We have got a wonderful chance to serve our mother India and to take our country to new economic heights
hi_text: माँ भारती की सेवा करने का एक अद्भुत मौका हमारे सामने आया है, देश को आर्थिक ऊंचाइयों पर ले जाने का अवसर आया है

text: Dear youngsters, can you please help me
hi_text: लेकिन मेरे प्यारे नौजवान मित्रो, मैं फिर एक बार कहता हूँ, मुझे इस काम में आपकी मदद चाहिए

text: You will be with me but that alone is not enough
hi_text: मेरे नौजवानो, आप मेरी मदद कर सकते हो क्या? मुझे साथ दोगे, इतने से बात बनने वाली नहीं है

text: The older generation does not have the exposure and experience of the new world which you possess
hi_text: जितना आज की दुनिया का अनुभव आपको है, पुरानी पीढ़ी को नहीं है

text: Possibly your elder brother and even your parents and uncles and aunts also may not know
hi_text: हो सकता है, आपके परिवार में बड़े भाई साहब को भी मालूम नहीं होगा और मातापिता, चाचाचाची, मामामामी को भी शायद मालूम नहीं होगा

text: You know what an 'App' is, what 'online banking' is and how 'online ticket booking' is done
hi_text: आप अप्प क्या होती है, वो जानते हो, ओनलाइन बैंकिंग क्या होता है, जानते हो, ओनलाइन टिकेट बुकिंग कैसे होता है, आप जानते हो

text: For you these are routine things and you also make use of them
hi_text: आपके लिये चीज़ें बहुत सामान्य हैं और आप उपयोग भी करते हो

text: But, the great task that the country wants to accomplish today is the realisation of our dream of a 'Cashless Society'
hi_text: लेकिन आज देश जिस महान कार्य को करना चाहता है, हमारा सपना है कैशलेस सोसाइटी

text: It is true that a hundred percent cashless society is not possible
hi_text: ये ठीक है कि शतप्रतिशत कैशलेस सोसाइटी संभव नहीं होती है

text: But why should India not make a beginning in creating a 'lesscash society'
hi_text: लेकिन क्यों न भारत लेसकैश सोसाइटी की तो शुरुआत करे

text: Once we embark on our journey to create a 'lesscash society', the goal of 'cashless society' will not remain very far
hi_text: एक बार अगर आज हम लेसकैश सोसाइटी की शुरुआत कर दें, तो कैशलेस सोसाइटी की मंज़िल दूर नहीं होगी

text: And I require your physical help, your own time, your own resolve and I am sure that you will not disappoint me because we are the ones nurturing the desire to change for better the life of the poor people of India
hi_text: और आप मुझे कभी निराश नहीं करोगे, मुझे विश्वास है, क्योंकि हम सब हिंदुस्तान के ग़रीब की ज़िंदगी बदलने की इच्छा रखने वाले लोग हैं

text: You know how many opportunities there are today for a cashless society, for digital banking or for mobile banking
hi_text: आप जानते हैं, कैशलेस सोसाइटी के लिये, डिजिटल बैंकिंग के लिये या मोबाइल बैंकिंग के लिये आज कितने सारे अवसर हैं

text: Every bank provides online banking facility
hi_text: हर बैंक ओनलाइन सुविधा देता है

text: Every bank in India has its own 'mobile App'
hi_text: हिंदुस्तान के हर एक बैंक की अपनी मोबाइल अप्प है

text: Every bank has its wallet
hi_text: हर बैंक का अपना वॉलेट है

text: Wallet simply means an epurse
hi_text: वॉलेट का सीधासीधा मतलब है eबटुवा

text: Various types of cards are available
hi_text: कई तरह के कार्ड उपलब्ध हैं

text: Under Jan Dhan Yojana, crores of poor families in India have Rupay Cards
hi_text: जनधन योजना के तहत भारत के करोड़ोंकरोड़ ग़रीब परिवारों के पास रूपे कार्ड है और 8 तारीख़ के बाद तो जो रूपे कार्ड का बहुत कम उपयोग होता था, गरीबों ने रूपे कार्ड का उपयोग करना शुरू किया और क़रीबकरीब 300% उसमें वृद्धि हुई है

text: Used scarcely earlier, after 8th November the poor people have started using Rupay Cards and this usage has seen almost 300% surge
hi_text: जनधन योजना के तहत भारत के करोड़ोंकरोड़ ग़रीब परिवारों के पास रूपे कार्ड है और 8 तारीख़ के बाद तो जो रूपे कार्ड का बहुत कम उपयोग होता था, गरीबों ने रूपे कार्ड का उपयोग करना शुरू किया और क़रीबकरीब 300% उसमें वृद्धि हुई है

text: Just as there is a prepaid card for mobile phones, prepaid cards are also available in banks to facilitate expenditure
hi_text: जैसे मोबाइल फोन में प्रीपेड कार्ड आता है, वैसा बैंकों में भी पैसा ख़र्च करने के लिये प्रीपेड कार्ड मिलता है

text: UPI is a very useful platform for carrying on trade activities which enables you to make purchases, send money and even receive money
hi_text: एक बढ़िया प्लैटफार्म है, कारोबार करने की उपी, जिससे आप ख़रीदी भी कर सकते हैं, पैसे भी भेज सकते हैं, पैसे ले भी सकते हैं

text: And, this procedure is as simple as sending messages through WhatsApp
hi_text: और ये काम इतना सिम्पल है जितना कि आप WhatsApp भेजते हैं

text: Even an illiterate person today knows how to send and also forward WhatsApp messages
hi_text: कुछ भी ना पढ़ालिखा व्यक्ति होगा, उसको भी आज WhatsApp कैसे भेजना है, वो आता है, फॉरवर्ड कैसे करना है, आता है

text: Not only this, with the simplification of technology, we do not require any big smart phones for this purpose
hi_text: इतना ही नहीं, टेक्नोलॉजी इतनी सरल होती जा रही है कि इस काम के लिए कोई बड़े स्मार्ट फोन की भी आवश्यकता नहीं है

text: Cash can be transferred even with a phone with ordinary features
hi_text: साधारण जो फीचर फोन होता है, उससे भी कैश ट्रांसफर हो सकती है

text: A washerman, vegetable vendor, milk supplier, newspaper vendor, tea stall owner or a chanaa vendor, everyone can easily use this facility
hi_text: धोबी हो, सब्ज़ी बेचनेवाला हो, दूध बेचनेवाला हो, अख़बार बेचनेवाला हो, चाय बेचनेवाला हो, चने बेचनेवाला हो, हर कोई इसका आराम से उपयोग कर सकता है

text: I have provided further impetus to simplifying this system even more
hi_text: और मैंने भी इस व्यवस्था को और अधिक सरल बनाने के लिए और ज़ोर दिया है

text: All banks are engaged in this and are doing their best
hi_text: सभी बैंक इस पर लगी हुई हैं, कर रही हैं

text: We have now cancelled the online surcharge and you might have seen in the newspapers during last 24 days that all extra charges for such cards have been abolished in order to strengthen the movement towards achieving a 'cashless society'
hi_text: और भी इस प्रकार के कार्ड वगैरह का जो ख़र्चा आता था, उसे आपने देखा होगा पिछले 24 दिन में अख़बारों में, सारे ख़र्चे ख़त्म कर दिए, ताकि कैशलेस सोसाइटी की मूवमेंट को बल मिले

text: My dear young friends, despite all these things, there is an entire generation which is ignorant in these matters
hi_text: मेरे नौजवान दोस्तो, ये सब होने के बाद भी एक पूरी पीढ़ी ऐसी है कि जो इससे अपरिचित है

text: And I know it very well that all of you are actively contributing in this great task
hi_text: और आप सभी लोग, मैं भलीभांति जानता हूँ, इस महान कार्य में सक्रिय हैं

text: The kind of creative messages that you send on WhatsApp slogans, poems, anecdotes, cartoons, new imagination, jokes I am seeing all these signifying the creative power of our young generation amidst the present challenges
hi_text: WhatsApp पर जिस प्रकार के क्रिएटिव मेसेज आप देते हैं स्लोगन, कवितायेँ, किस्से, कार्टून, नयीनयी कल्पना, हंसीमज़ाक सब कुछ मैं देख रहा हूँ और चुनौतियों के बीच ये हमारी युवा पीढ़ी की जो सृजन शक्ति है, तो ऐसा लग रहा है, जैसे ये भारत भूमि की विशेषता है कि किसी ज़माने में युद्ध के मैदान में गीता का जन्म हुआ था, वैसे ही आज इतने बड़े बदलाव के काल से हम गुजर रहे हैं, तब आपके अन्दर भी मौलिक क्रिएटिविटी प्रकट हो रही है

text: This is the speciality of our 'Bharat Bhoomi', our motherland where GITA was created on a battlefield
hi_text: माँ भारती की सेवा करने का एक अद्भुत मौका हमारे सामने आया है, देश को आर्थिक ऊंचाइयों पर ले जाने का अवसर आया है

text: Today when we are passing through the times of such gigantic changes, your original creativity is manifesting itself within you
hi_text: आज फिर एक बार, उस चुनौती को उन्होंने लिया है और मुझे विश्वास है कि सवासौ करोड़ देशवासियों का संकल्प, सबका सामूहिक पुरुषार्थ, इस राष्ट्र को एक नई ताक़त बना करके प्रशस्त करेगा

text: But, my dear young friends, I once again tell you that I need your help in this task
hi_text: लेकिन मेरे प्यारे नौजवान मित्रो, मैं फिर एक बार कहता हूँ, मुझे इस काम में आपकी मदद चाहिए

text: Yes, yes, yes I repeat that I NEED YOUR HELP and I am very sure that millions of young people of our country will accomplish this tremendous task
hi_text: जीजीजी, मैं दुबारा कहता हूँ, मुझे आपकी मदद चाहिए और आप, आप मुझे विश्वास है मेरे देश के करोड़ों नौजवान इस काम को करेंगे

text: You just do one thing, take a resolve today itself that you will yourself become a part of the 'cashless society'
hi_text: आप एक काम कीजिए, आज से ही संकल्प लीजिए कि आप स्वयं कैशलेस सोसाइटी के लिए ख़ुद एक हिस्सा बनेंगे

text: Every technology needed for online spending will definitely be available on your mobile phone

hi_text: इसलिए, इस दौरान लिए जा रहे फैसले भी ऐसे हैं, जो, दुनिया के इतिहास में कभी देखने और सुनने को नहीं मिले

hi_text: कोरोना को रोकने के लिए जो तमाम कदम भारतवासियों ने उठाए हैं, जो प्रयास अभी हम कर रहे हैं वही, भारत को कोरोना महामारी पर जीत दिलायेंगे

text: In addition, our sympathy for the poor should also be far greater

text: Our humanity stems from the fact that whenever we see a poor or hungry person, we first try and feed him or her in this time of crisis
hi_text: हमारी मानवता का वास इस बात मे है कि कहीं पर भी कोई ग़रीब, दुखी भूखा नज़र आता है, तो, इस संकट की घड़ी में हम पहले उसका पेट भरेंगे, उसका जरूरत की चिंता करेंगे और ये हिंदुस्तान कर सकता है

text: We should think of their needs and India can do this
hi_text: भारत में ऐसी स्थिति न आये इसके लिए ही हमें निरंतर प्रयास करना है

text: These are a part of our values and culture

text: Stay at home with your family, be careful and safe, we need to win this battle

text: And we will win
hi_text: जरूर जीतेगें

text: We will meet in Man ki baat again next month
hi_text: आमतौर पर 'मन की बात', उसमें मैं कई विषयों को ले करके आता हूँ

text: By then we should have overcome this crisis with this hope, and this wish, I thank you all
hi_text: 'मन की बात' के लिए, फिर, अगले महीने मिलेगें और तब तक इस संकटों को मात करने में हम सफल हो भी जाएँ, इसी एक कल्पना के साथ, इसी एक शुभकामना के साथ, आप सबको बहुतबहुत धन्यवाद

text: My fellow citizens, my namaskar to all of you
hi_text: मेरे प्यारे देशवासियो, आप सबको नमस्कार

text: 26th January, our Republic Day was celebrated with joy and enthusiasm in every nook and corner of the nation by all of us
hi_text: 26 जनवरी, हमारा 'गणतंत्र दिवस' देश के कोनेकोने में उमंग और उत्साह के साथ हम सबने मनाया

text: The Constitution of India, the duties of citizens, the rights of citizens and our commitment to democracy these in a way make Republic Day also a festival of 'sanskaars', which makes our future generations cognizant of democracy and their democratic responsibilities, and also imparts to them the culture, moral values and norms inherent in our democracy
hi_text: भारत का संविधान, नागरिकों के कर्तव्य, नागरिकों के अधिकार, लोकतंत्र के प्रति हमारी प्रतिबद्धता, एक प्रकार से ये संस्कार उत्सव भी है, जो आने वाली पीढ़ियों को लोकतंत्र के प्रति, लोकतान्त्रिक जिम्मेवारियों के प्रति, जागरूक भी करता है, संस्कारित भी करता है

text: But still in our country, the duties and rights of citizens are not being debated and discussed as intensively and extensively as it should be done
hi_text: लेकिन अभी भी हमारे देश में, नागरिकों के कर्तव्य और नागरिकों के अधिकार उस पर जितनी बहस होनी चाहिए, जितनी गहराई से बहस होनी चाहिए, जितनी व्यापक रूप में चर्चा होनी चाहिए, वो अभी नहीं हो रही है

text: I hope that the amount of emphasis that is given to the rights at every level during most of the time, is also given to discussing duties of citizens in an emphatic manner
hi_text: मैं आशा करता हूँ कि हर स्तर पर, हर वक़्त, जितना बल अधिकारों पर दिया जाता है, उतना ही बल कर्तव्यों पर भी दिया जाए

text: The rights and duties of the citizens constitute the railway track, on which the train of democracy in India can move ahead at a fast pace
hi_text: अधिकार और कर्तव्य की दो पटरी पर ही, भारत के लोकतंत्र की गाड़ी तेज़ गति से आगे बढ़ सकती है

text: Tomorrow is 30th January, the death anniversary of our revered Bapu
hi_text: कल 30 जनवरी है, हमारे पूज्य बापू की पुण्य तिथि है

text: All of us pay tributes to the martyrs who sacrificed their lives for the motherland, by observing silence for 2 minutes at 11 am on 30th January
hi_text: 30 जनवरी को हम सब सुबह 11 बजे, 2 मिनट मौन रख करके, देश के लिए प्राण न्योछावर करने वाले शहीदों को श्रद्धांजलि देते हैं

text: As a society, as a nation, the 2 minute tribute of silence on 30th January at 11 am, should become our instinctive nature
hi_text: एक समाज के रूप में, एक देश के रूप में, 30 जनवरी, 11 बजे 2 मिनट श्रद्धांजलि, यह सहज स्वभाव बनना चाहिए

text: This 2 minutes silence is an expression of our collective resolve and reverence for the martyrs
hi_text: 2 मिनट क्यों न हो, लेकिन उसमें सामूहिकता भी, संकल्प भी और शहीदों के प्रति श्रद्धा भी अभिव्यक्त होती है

text: In our country there is an innate respect for the military and the security forces
hi_text: हमारे देश में सेना के प्रति, सुरक्षा बलों के प्रति, एक सहज आदर भाव प्रकट होता रहता है

text: I congratulate and felicitate the young heroes and their families who were honoured with various gallantry awards on the eve of this Republic Day
hi_text: इस गणतंत्र दिवस की पूर्व संध्या पर, विभिन्न वीरता पुरस्कारों से, जो वीरजवान सम्मानित हुए, उनको, उनके परिवारजनों को, मैं बधाई देता हूँ

text: There are various categories of these gallantry awards like Kirti Chakra, Shaurya Chakra, Vishisht Seva Medal and Param Vishisht Seva Medal
hi_text: इन पुरस्कारों में, 'कीर्ति चक्र', 'शौर्य चक्र', 'परम विशिष्ट सेवा मेडल', 'विशिष्ट सेवा मेडल' अनेक श्रेणियाँ हैं

text: I want to urge the youth especially that since you are very active on social media, you can do one thing
hi_text: मैं ख़ास करके नौजवानों से आग्रह करना चाहता हूँ

text: Surf the Net to do some research on the valiant bravehearts, who have been bestowed with these honours, compose a few good lines about them and share these with your friends and companions
hi_text: आप एक काम कर सकते हैं? इस बार, जिनजिन वीरों को ये सम्मान मिला है आप नेट पर खोजिए, उनके संबंध में दो अच्छे शब्द लिखिए और अपने साथियों में उसको पहुँचाइए

text: When we get to know the in depth details of their courage, bravery, valour in detail, we are filled with astonishment and pride and we also get inspired
hi_text: जब उनके साहस की, वीरता की, पराक्रम की बात को गहराई से जानते हैं, तो हमें आश्चर्य भी होता है, गर्व भी होता है, प्रेरणा भी मिलती है

text: While we were all delighted with the tidings of enthusiasm and celebration of 26th January, at the same time, some of our army Jawans posted in Kashmir for the defense of the country, achieved martyrdom due to the avalanche
hi_text: एक तरफ़ हम सब 26 जनवरी की उमंग और उत्साह की ख़बरों से आनंदित थे, तो उसी समय कश्मीर में हमारे जो सेना के जवान देश की रक्षा में डटे हुए हैं, वे हिमस्खलन के कारण वीरगति को प्राप्त हुए

text: I respectfully pay my homage to all these brave soldiers, I bow to them
hi_text: मैं इन सभी वीर जवानों को आदरपूर्वक श्रद्धांजलि देता हूँ, नमन करता हूँ

text: My young friends, you know very well that I regularly do my 'Mann Ki Baat'
hi_text: मेरे युवा साथियो, आप तो भलीभाँति जानते हैं कि मैं 'मन की बात' लगातार करता रहता हूँ

text: January, February, March, April all these are for every family, months of most severe test
hi_text: जनवरी, फ़रवरी, मार्च, अप्रैल ये सारे महीने हर परिवार में, कसौटी के महीने होते हैं

text: Normally it is one or two children in a home due to appear at their exams, but the entire family feels the burden of it
hi_text: घर में एकआध, दो बच्चों की एक्साम होती हैं, लेकिन पूरा परिवार एक्साम के बोझ में दबा हुआ होता है

text: This led me to believe that this is the right time for me to talk to my student friends, their guardians and their teachers, because for many years now, wherever I have gone, whomsoever I have met, examination appeared to be a great source of anxiety
hi_text: क्योंकि कई वर्षों से, मैं जहाँ गया, जिसे मिला, परीक्षा एक बहुत बड़ा परेशानी का कारण नज़र आया

text: Troubled families, harassed students, tense teachers one sees a very strange psychological atmosphere prevailing in each home
hi_text: परिवार परेशान, विद्यार्थी परेशान, शिक्षक परेशान, एक बड़ा विचित्र सा मनोवैज्ञानिक वातावरण हर घर में नज़र आता है

text: And I have always felt that we should come out of this situation and, therefore, today I want to talk in some detail with my young friends
hi_text: और मुझे हमेशा ये लगा है कि इसमें से बाहर आना चाहिये और इसलिये मैं आज युवा साथियों के साथ कुछ विस्तार से बातें करना चाहता हूँ

text: When I'd declared that I would talk on this topic, many teachers, guardians and students sent me their messages, questions, suggestions and also expressed their anguish and narrated their problems

text: And after going through all these outpourings, some ideas came to my mind, which I want to share with you today
hi_text: और मुझे हमेशा ये लगा है कि इसमें से बाहर आना चाहिये और इसलिये मैं आज युवा साथियों के साथ कुछ विस्तार से बातें करना चाहता हूँ

text: I received a telephonic message from Srishti

text: You too listen to what Srishti has to say
hi_text: आप भी सुनिए, सृष्टि क्या कह रही है

text: "Sir, I want to tell you that during exam time, very often in our homes, in the neighbourhood and in our society, a very terrifying and scary atmosphere pervades
hi_text: "सर, मैं आपसे इतना कहना चाहती हूँ कि एक्साम्स के टाइम पे अक्सर ऐसा होता है कि हमारे घर में, आसपड़ोस में, हमारी सोसाइटी में बहुत ही ख़ौफ़नाक और डरावना माहौल बन जाता है

text: This leads to a situation, where the students instead of feeling inspired feel tremendously down
hi_text: इस वजह से स्टूडेंट इंस्पिरेशन तो कम, लेकिन डाउन बहुत हो जाते है

text: So I just want to ask you this, can't this be transformed into a pleasant atmosphere
hi_text: तो मैं आपसे इतना पूछना चाहती हूँ कि क्या ये माहौल ख़ुशनुमा नहीं हो सकता?"

text: Well, the question has been posed by Srishti, but it is a question that must be there in the minds of all of you
hi_text: खैर, सवाल तो सृष्टि ने पूछा है, लेकिन ये सवाल आप सबके मन में होगा

text: Exams in themselves, should be a joyous occasion
hi_text: परीक्षा अपनेआप में एक ख़ुशी का अवसर होना चाहिये

text: After a year of hard work, one has the opportunity to display one's capabilities, so this should be a festival of joy and enthusiasm
hi_text: साल भर मेहनत की है, अब बताने का अवसर आया है, ऐसा उमंगउत्साह का ये पर्व होना चाहिए

text: But there are very few people for whom there is pleasure in the exam; for most people exam means pressure
hi_text: बहुत कम लोग हैं, जिनके लिए एक्साम में प्लेजर होती है, ज़्यादातर लोगों के लिए एक्साम एक प्रेशर होती है

text: Now, it is up to you to decide whether you consider the exams pleasure or pressure
hi_text: निर्णय आपको करना है कि इसे आप प्लेजर मानेंगे कि प्रेशर मानेंगे

text: Those who will consider it a pleasure, will have achievements, while those who will consider exams a pressure, will have to repent
hi_text: जो प्लेजर मानेगा, वो पायेगा; जो प्रेशर मानेगा, वो पछताएगा

text: And therefore my opinion is that exams are like a festival and, hence, must be celebrated
hi_text: और इसलिये मेरा मत है कि परीक्षा एक उत्सव है, परीक्षा को ऐसे लीजिए, जैसे मानो त्योहार है

text: And when there is a festive mood of celebration, the best within us comes out
hi_text: और जब त्योहार होता है, जब उत्सव होता है, तो हमारे भीतर जो सबसे बेस्ट होता है, वही बाहर निकल कर के आता है

text: The true realisation of the strength of a society also takes place during festivals
hi_text: समाज की भी ताक़त की अनुभूति उत्सव के समय होती है

text: The best of everything finds a manifestation

hi_text: आप जानते हैं, पेंटिंग कला और कैनवास से जुड़ा काम है, लेकिन, राघवन जी ने तय किया कि वो अपनी पेंटिंग्स के जरिए पेड़पौधों और जीव जंतुओं की जानकारी को संरक्षित करेंगे

text: He documents the information related to them by making paintings of varied Flora and Fauna
hi_text: वो अलगअलग फ्लोरा और फौना की पेंटिंग्स बनाकर उनसे जुड़ी जानकारी का डॉक्यूमेंटेशन करते हैं

text: Till now he has made paintings of dozens of such birds, animals, orchids, which are on the verge of extinction
hi_text: वो अब तक दर्जनों ऐसी चिड़ियाओं की, पशुओं की, आर्किड्स की पेंटिंग्स बना चुके हैं, जो विलुप्त होने की कगार पर हैं

text: This example of serving nature through art is really amazing
hi_text: कला के जरिए प्रकृति की सेवा करने का ये उदाहरण वाकई अद्भुत है

text: My dear countrymen, today I want to tell you one more interesting thing
hi_text: मेरे प्यारे देशवासियो, आज मैं आपको एक और दिलचस्प बात भी बताना चाहता हूँ

text: A few days ago an awesome craze appeared on social media
hi_text: कुछ दिन पहले सोशल मीडिया पर एक अद्भुत क्रेज दिखा

text: America has returned to us more than a hundred rare and ancient artefacts
hi_text: अमेरिका ने हमें सौ से ज्यादा दुर्लभ और प्राचीन कलाकृतियाँ वापस लौटाई हैं

text: After this news came to the fore, there was a lot of discussion on social media about these artefacts
hi_text: इस खबर के सामने आने के बाद सोशल मीडिया पर इन कलाकृतियों को लेकर खूब चर्चा हुई

text: The youth displayed a sense of pride in their heritage
hi_text: युवाओं में अपनी विरासत के प्रति गर्व का भाव दिखा

text: These artefacts returned to India are 2500 to 250 years old
hi_text: भारत लौटीं ये कलाकृतियाँ ढाई हजार साल से लेकर ढाई सौ साल तक पुरानी हैं

text: You will also be happy to know that these rare items are related to different regions of the country
hi_text: आपको यह भी जानकर खुशी होगी कि इन दुर्लभ चीजों का नाता देश के अलगअलग क्षेत्रों से है

text: These have been made using Terracotta, Stone, Metal and Wood
hi_text: ये टेराकोटा, स्टोन, मेटल और लकड़ी के इस्तेमाल से बनाई गई हैं

text: Some of these are such that they will fill you with wonder
hi_text: इनमें से कुछ तो ऐसी हैं, जो आपको, आश्चर्य से भर देंगी

text: If you have a look at them, you will be left mesmerised
hi_text: आप इन्हें देखेंगे, तो देखते ही रह जायेंगे

text: You will also get to see a beautiful sandstone sculpture of the 11th century among these
hi_text: इनमें 11वीं शताब्दी का एक खुबसूरत सैंडस्टोन स्कल्पचर स्कल्पचर भी आपको देखने को मिलेगा

text: This is an artwork of an 'Apsara' dancing, which belongs to Madhya Pradesh
hi_text: ये नृत्य करती हुई एक 'अप्सरा' की कलाकृति है, जिसका नाता, मध्य प्रदेश से है

text: Many idols of the Chola era are also part of these
hi_text: चोल युग की कई मूर्तियाँ भी इनमें शामिल हैं

text: The idols of Devi and Lord Murugan date back to the 12th century and are associated with the rich culture of Tamil Nadu
hi_text: देवी और भगवान मुर्गन की प्रतिमाएँ तो 12वीं शताब्दी की हैं और तमिलनाडु की वैभवशाली संस्कृति से जुड़ी हैं

text: Nearly a thousand year old bronze statue of Lord Ganesha has also been returned to India
hi_text: भगवान गणेश की करीब एक हजार वर्ष पुरानी कांसे की प्रतिमा भी भारत को लौटाई गई है

text: An idol of UmaMaheshwara in Lalitasan is said to be of the 11th century, in which both of them are seated on Nandi
hi_text: ललितासन में बैठे उमामहेश्वर की एक मूर्ति 11वीं शताब्दी की बताई जाती है जिसमें वह दोनों नंदी पर आसीन हैं

text: Two stone idols of Jain Tirthankaras have also come back to India
hi_text: पत्थरों से बनी जैन तीर्थंकरों की दो मूर्तियाँ भी भारत वापस आई हैं

text: Two idols of Bhagwan Surya Dev will also enthrall you
hi_text: भगवान सूर्य देव की दो प्रतिमाएं भी आपका मन मोह लेंगी

text: One of these is made of Sandstone
hi_text: इनमें से एक सैंडस्टोन से बनी है

text: Among the items returned is a panel made of wood, which brings to the fore the story of the churning of the ocean
hi_text: वापस लौटाई गई चीजों में लकड़ी से बना एक पैनल भी है, जो समुद्रमंथन की कथा को सामने लाता है

text: This panel of 16th17th century is associated with South India
hi_text: 16वीं17वीं सदी के इस पनेल पैनल का जुड़ाव दक्षिण भारत से है

text: Friends, I have mentioned just a few names here, whereas, if you see, this list is very long
hi_text: साथियो, यहाँ मैंने तो बहुत कम ही नाम लिए हैं, जबकि देखें, तो यह लिस्ट, बहुत लंबी है

text: I would like to thank the American government, who have returned this valuable heritage of ours
hi_text: मैं, अमेरिकी सरकार का आभार करना चाहूँगा, जिन्होंने हमारी इस बहुमूल्य विरासत को, लौटाया है

text: Even when I visited America in 2016 and 2021, many artefacts were returned to India
hi_text: 2016 और 2021 में भी जब मैंने अमेरिका की यात्रा की थी, तब भी कई कलाकृतियाँ भारत को लौटाई गई थी

text: I am sure that with such efforts, awareness will increase across the country to stop the theft of our cultural heritage
hi_text: मुझे विश्वास है कि ऐसे प्रयासों से हमारी सांस्कृतिक धरोहरों की चोरी रोकने को इस बात को ले करके देशभर में जागरूकता बढ़ेगी

text: This will further deepen the attachment of the countrymen with our rich heritage
hi_text: इससे हमारी समृद्ध विरासत से देशवासियों का लगाव भी और गहरा होगा

text: My dear countrymen, the letters written by some mothers and sisters of Devbhoomi Uttarakhand to me are touchingly heartwarming
hi_text: मेरे प्यारे देशवासियो, देवभूमि उत्तराखंड की कुछ माताओं और बहनों ने जो पत्र मुझे लिखे हैं, वो भावुक कर देने वाले हैं

text: They have given many blessings to their son, their brother
hi_text: उन्होंने अपने बेटे को, अपने भाई को, खूब सारा आशीर्वाद दिया है

text: They have written that 'They had never imagined that our erstwhile cultural heritage 'Bhojpatra' could become a means of their livelihood
hi_text: उन्होंने लिखा है कि 'उन्होंने कभी कल्पना भी नहीं की थी, कि हमारी सांस्कृतिक धरोहर रहा 'भोजपत्र', उनकी आजीविका का, साधन, बन सकता है

text: You must be wondering what the entire matter is
hi_text: आप सोच रहे होंगे कि यह पूरा माजरा है क्या ?

text: Friends, this letter has been written to me by the women of NitiMana valley in Chamoli district
hi_text: साथियो, मुझे यह पत्र लिखे हैं चमोली जिले की नीतीमाणा घाटी की महिलाओं ने

text: These are the women who had presented me a unique artwork on Bhojpatra in October last year
hi_text: ये वो महिलाएं हैं, जिन्होंने पिछले साल अक्टूबर में मुझे भोजपत्र पर एक अनूठी कलाकृति भेंट की थी

text: I was also overwhelmed on receiving this gift
hi_text: यह उपहार पाकर मैं भी बहुत अभिभूत हो गया

text: After all, since ancient times, our scriptures and books have been preserved on these Bhojpatras
hi_text: आखिर, हमारे यहाँ प्राचीन काल से हमारे शास्त्र और ग्रंथ, इन्हीं भोजपत्रों पर सहेजे जाते रहे हैं

text: Mahabharata was also written on the Bhojpatra
hi_text: महाभारत भी तो इसी भोजपत्र पर लिखा गया था

text: Today, these women of Devbhoomi are making very beautiful artefacts and souvenirs from the Bhojpatra
hi_text: आज, देवभूमि की ये महिलाएं, इस भोजपत्र से, बेहद ही सुंदरसुंदर कलाकृतियाँ और स्मृति चिन्ह बना रही हैं

text: During my visit to Mana village, I had appreciated his unique effort
hi_text: माणा गांव की यात्रा के दौरान मैंने उनके इस यूनिक प्रयास की सराहना की थी

text: I had appealed to the tourists coming to Devbhoomi to buy as many local products as possible during their visit
hi_text: मैंने, देवभूमि आने वाले पर्यटकों से अपील की थी, कि वो, यात्रा के दौरान ज्यादा से ज्यादा लोकल प्रोडक्ट्स खरीदें

text: It has had a great impact there
hi_text: इसका वहाँ बहुत असर हुआ है

text: Today, the products of Bhojpatra are very much liked by the pilgrims coming here and are also buying it at good prices
hi_text: आज, भोजपत्र के उत्पादों को यहाँ आने वाले तीर्थयात्री काफी पसंद कर रहे हैं और इसे अच्छे दामों पर खरीद भी रहे हैं

text: This ancient heritage of Bhojpatra is filling new hues of happiness in the lives of the women of Uttarakhand
hi_text: भोजपत्र की यह प्राचीन विरासत, उत्तराखंड की महिलाओं के जीवन में खुशहाली के नएनए रंग भर रही है

text: I am also happy to know that the state government is also imparting training to women to make novel products from Bhojpatra
hi_text: मुझे यह जानकर भी खुशी हुई है कि भोजपत्र से नएनए प्रोडक्ट बनाने के लिए राज्य सरकार, महिलाओं को ट्रेनिंग भी दे रही है

text: The state government has also started a campaign to preserve the rare species of Bhojpatra
hi_text: राज्य सरकार ने भोजपत्र की दुर्लभ प्रजातियों को संरक्षित करने के लिए भी अभियान शुरू किया है

text: The areas which were once considered as the last point of the land are now being developed considering them as the first villages of the country
hi_text: जिन क्षेत्रों को कभी देश का आखिरी छोर माना गया था, उन्हें अब, देश का प्रथम गाँव मानकर विकास हो रहा है

text: Along with preserving our tradition and culture, this effort is also becoming a means of economic progress
hi_text: ये प्रयास अपनी परंपरा और संस्कृति को संजोने के साथ आर्थिक तरक्की का भी जरिया बन रहा है

text: My dear countrymen, I have also received a large number of such letters this time in 'Man Ki Baat' that give a lot of satisfaction to the mind
hi_text: मेरे प्यारे देशवासियो, 'मन की बात' में मुझे इस बार काफी संख्या में ऐसे पत्र भी मिले हैं, जो मन को बहुत ही संतोष देते है

text: These letters have been written by those Muslim women who have recently come from Haj pilgrimage
hi_text: ये चिट्ठी उन मुस्लिम महिलाओं ने लिखी हैं, जो हाल ही में हज यात्रा करके आई हैं

text: This journey of theirs is very special in many ways
hi_text: उनकी ये यात्रा कई मायनों में बहुत खास है

text: These are the women, who have performed Hajj without any male companion or mehram, and the number is not fifty or hundred, but more than four thousand this is a huge transformation
hi_text: ये वो महिलाएं हैं, जिन्होंने, हज की यात्रा, बिना किसी पुरुष सहयोगी या मेहरम के बिना पूरी की है और ये संख्या सौपचास नहीं, बल्कि, 4 हज़ार से ज्यादा है यह एक बड़ा बदलाव है

text: Earlier, Muslim women were not allowed to perform 'Hajj' without Mehram
hi_text: पहले, मुस्लिम महिलाओं को बिना मेहरम, 'हज' करने की इजाजत नहीं थी

text: Through Mann Ki Baat, I also express my heartfelt gratitude to the Government of Saudi Arabia
hi_text: मैं 'मन की बात' के माध्यम से सऊदी अरब सरकार का भी ह्रदय से आभार व्यक्त करता हूँ

text: Women coordinators were specially appointed for women going on 'Haj' without Mehram
hi_text: बिना मेहरम 'हज' पर जा रही महिलाओं के लिए ख़ासतौर पर वूमेन कोआर्डिनेटर्स नियुक्ति की गई थी

text: Friends, the changes that have been made in the Haj Policy in the last few years are being highly appreciated
hi_text: साथियो, बीते कुछ वर्षों में हज पॉलिसी में जो बदलाव किए गए हैं, उनकी भरपूर सराहना हो रही है

text: Our Muslim mothers and sisters have written a lot to me about this
hi_text: हमारी मुस्लिम माताओं और बहनों ने इस बारे में मुझे काफी कुछ लिखा है

text: Now, more and more people are getting the chance to go for 'Haj'
hi_text: अब, ज्यादा से ज्यादा लोगों को 'हज' पर जाने का मौका मिल रहा है

text: The blessing given by the people who have returned from Haj pilgrimage, especially our mothers and sisters through their letters, is very inspiring in itself
hi_text: 'हज यात्रा' से लौटे लोगों ने, विशेषकर हमारी माताओंबहनों ने चिट्ठी लिखकर जो आशीर्वाद दिया है, वो अपने आप में बहुत प्रेरक है

text: My dear countrymen, whether be the Musical Nights in Jammu Kashmir, Bike Rallies at High Altitudes, local clubs in Chandigarh, and the many sports groups in Punjab,... it sounds like we are talking about entertainment and adventure
hi_text: मेरे प्यारे देशवासियो, जम्मूकश्मीर में म्यूजिकल नाइट्स हों, हिघ अल्टीट्यूड्स में बाइक रैलीज हों, चंडीगढ़ के लोकल क्लब्स हों, और, पंजाब में ढेर सारे स्पोर्ट्स ग्रुप्स हों, ये सुनकर लगता है, एंटरटेनमेंट की बात हो रही है , एडवेंचर की बात हो रही है

text: But it's something different..., this event is also related to a 'common cause'
hi_text: लेकिन बात कुछ और है, ये आयोजन एक 'कॉमन काउज' से भी जुड़ा हुआ है

text: And this common cause is the awareness campaign against drugs
hi_text: और ये कॉमन काउज है ड्रग्स के खिलाफ जागरूकता अभियान

text: To save the youth of Jammu and Kashmir from drugs, many innovative efforts have been visible
hi_text: जम्मूकश्मीर के युवाओं को ड्रग्स से बचाने के लिए कई इनोवेटिव प्रयास देखने को मिले हैं

text: Programs like Musical Night, Bike Rallies are happening there
hi_text: यहाँ, म्यूजिकल नाइट, बाइक रैलीज जैसे कार्यक्रम हो रहे हैं

text: To spread this message in Chandigarh, Local Clubs have been linked with it
hi_text: चंडीगढ़ में इस मेसेज को स्प्रेड करने के लिए लोकल क्लब्स को इससे जोड़ा गया है

text: They call these VADA clubs
hi_text: वे इन्हें वादा वादा क्लब्स कहते हैं

text: VADA means Victory Against Drug Abuse
hi_text: वादा यानी विक्ट्री अगेंस्ट ड्रग्स एब्यूज

text: Many sports groups have also been formed in Punjab, which are running awareness campaigns to focus on fitness and get rid of drug addiction
hi_text: पंजाब में कई स्पोर्ट्स ग्रुप्स भी बनाए गए हैं, जो फिटनेस पर ध्यान देने और नशा मुक्ति के लिए अवेयरनेस कैम्पेन चला रहे हैं

text: The increasing participation of youth in the campaign against drug abuse is very encouraging
hi_text: नशे के खिलाफ अभियान में युवाओं की बढ़ती भागीदारी बहुत उत्साह बढ़ाने वाली है

text: These efforts lend a lot of strength to the campaign against drugs in India
hi_text: ये प्रयास, भारत में नशे के खिलाफ अभियान को बहुत ताकत देते हैं

text: If we want to save the future generations of the country, we have to keep them away from drugs
hi_text: हमें देश की भावी पीढ़ियों को बचाना है, तो उन्हें, ड्रग्स से दूर रखना ही होगा

text: With this thought, 'NashaMukt Bharat Abhiyan' was launched on the 15 August 2020
hi_text: इसी सोच के साथ, 15 अगस्त 2020 को 'नशा मुक्त भारत अभियान' की शुरुआत की गई थी

text: More than 11 crore people have been connected with this campaign
hi_text: इस अभियान से 11 करोड़ से ज्यादा लोगों को जोड़ा गया है

text: Two weeks ago, India has taken a huge action against drugs
hi_text: दो हफ्ते पहले ही भारत ने ड्रग्स के खिलाफ बहुत बड़ी कारवाई की है
